d: Long, straight midnight-blue hair flows from a pointed headdress, with a single lock framing a pale, mature face featuring narrow, glowing yellow eyes and a sinister grin. The build is extremely slender and elongated, draped in a floor-length black gown accented by dark teal armor plates and glowing lime-green gemstones. A large, ornate scythe with a teal crystal charm is held in one hand, while the other holds a realistic red heart. BODY COLOR: pale grey LEGS: plantigrade, hidden beneath a long gown
